140.long_description: We are adding a worldwide distribution network to sell our full range of products including our Arcooda LCD arcade monitors, Arcooda Pinball products, Game Wizard series including Tempest and Xtreme 3, and a number of components including gun pedal, power supplies and upcoming products.
